tools.name: find_house
tools.description: Look up a Vancouver address, or a resident's surname from 1945 or earlier, in AddressLore's coverage. Returns the matching house's path for house_history, or says plainly that the address isn't covered (never a nearby house in its place), with the covered streets.

tools.name: house_history
tools.description: When a covered Vancouver house was built and what stood there: the building permit (1901–1930) and the City's year built, what the 1912 fire insurance map draws on the lot and whether today's building is very likely that one, what stands today, and who lived there in each directory year with each li

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: The Vancouver streets, blocks and directory years AddressLore covers, with each street's page: every directory year read with names (each area's and street's extra years said), the years read for the whole city, the later years that hold buildings and places only, and the census years.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "coverage" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The Vancouver streets, blocks and directory years AddressLore covers, with each street's page." → after: "The Vancouver streets, blocks and directory years AddressLore covers, with each street's page: every directory year read with names (each area's and street's extra years said), the years read for the whole city, the later years that hold buildings and places only, and the census years."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
